changeSet.author: hwmdm
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO permissions (name, description, superAdmin) VALUES ('plugin_webfilter_access', 'Web Filter: gerenciar bloqueio de sites e aplicativos por perfil', FALSE); INSERT INTO userRolePermissions (roleId, permissionId) SELECT DISTINCT r.id, (SELECT id FROM permissions WHERE name = 'plugin_webfilter_access') FROM userroles r WHERE r.superAdmin OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM userRolePermissions urp JOIN permissions p ON p.id = urp.permissionId WHERE urp.roleId = r.id AND p.name = 'configurations');

changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE plugin_webfilter_delivery ( deviceId INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT plugin_webfilter_delivery_pr_key PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, customerId INT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, configurationId INT NOT NULL, enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, policyUpdatedAt BIGINT, deliveredAt BIGINT NOT NULL, browserSites INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, hiddenApps INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 );
CREATE TABLE plugin_webfilter_events ( id SERIAL NOT NULL CONSTRAINT plugin_webfilter_events_pr_key PRIMARY KEY, customerId INT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, deviceId INT NOT NULL REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, configurationId INT, host VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, url VARCHAR(1000), category VARCHAR(50), source VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, createdAt BIGINT NOT NULL ); CREATE INDEX plugin_webfilter_events_customer_time ON plugin_webfilter_events (customerId, createdAt DESC);
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE plugin_webfilter_events; DROP TABLE plugin_webfilter_delivery;
